      EXACT RESIDUAL.

      Construct the two coordinate maps jointly from the supplied head isometry. Descend their pair through corrBalSubmodule and SeparationQuotient, prove the joint inner-product identity, and construct the inverse using the inverse head isometry.

      Individual coordinate projections cannot be passed to corrTensorMapOfHead0Iso.
